review_views.label: 全体構図
review_views.evidence: Base, raw, protected final, guides, masks, report, and diagnostics were independently inspected.
review_views.notes: Two main relief fields are clear; the intended six-landform topology is not.

review_views.label: 原寸100%
review_views.evidence: The full 1536x1024 final was reviewed at native size.
review_views.notes: At least fifteen rosette-like mounds are visible across the two main relief fields, while the foothills vanish.

review_views.label: 200%・400%拡大
review_views.evidence: Per-landform raw/final crops and quantitative difference panels were reviewed.
review_views.notes: Final changed-pixel support above five levels is 16.94%, 41.23%, 28.07%, and 12.10% for the four foothills; none reads as an independent landform.

review_views.label: 中央・四隅・四辺の9領域
review_views.evidence: The full final, protection evidence, and border metrics were checked across all nine regions.
review_views.notes: All external borders are unchanged; visible faults are inside the two declared relief areas.

review_views.label: 制御図との半透明重ね合わせ
review_views.evidence: The six skeleton footprints and their raw-to-final retention were compared.
review_views.notes: Raw-to-final mean-difference retention is only 17.90%, 38.13%, 34.26%, and 14.00% for the four foothills.

review_views.label: 親ズーム画像との比較
review_views.evidence: Candidate D v4 and G3 were compared at equal extent and reduced scale.
review_views.notes: Paper color continues, but radial relief density jumps and secondary terrain disappears.

review_views.label: 四方向の隣接合成
review_views.evidence: All four borders and road-adjacent crops were checked.
review_views.notes: Canvas-edge continuity passes; broad road-shaped internal flat bands remain visible.

review_views.label: ベクターラベル・道路・POI重畳
review_views.evidence: Road, settlement, coast, forest, field, and future overlay zones were reviewed.
review_views.notes: Protected vectors remain exact, but dense mounds and mask voids disrupt the visual hierarchy.

review_views.label: Leafletデスクトップ表示
review_views.evidence: Desktop suitability was assessed from native and enlarged images without publishing a rejected raster.
review_views.notes: Repetitive rosettes remain obvious at normal scale.

review_views.label: Leafletモバイル表示
review_views.evidence: Mobile suitability was assessed from the reduced overview without publishing a rejected raster.
review_views.notes: Only the two primary dark fields remain legible.

immediate_failures.label: 海岸線・河川・主要道路・城壁の移動
immediate_failures.evidence: All automated protection gates and four border checks report zero changed pixels and zero maximum channel difference.

immediate_failures.label: 必須地点・地形の欠落
immediate_failures.evidence: NE-west and SE-east disappear, SE-west is substrate-like, and NE-central survives only as fragments; all four required foothills fail independent recognition.

immediate_failures.label: 正典外の主要都市・施設
immediate_failures.evidence: No noncanonical settlement, facility, route, or major landmark was added.

immediate_failures.label: AI生成文字・記号
immediate_failures.evidence: No generated text, pseudo-text, legend, compass, scale, signature, or route label was found.

immediate_failures.label: 目視できる継ぎ目
immediate_failures.evidence: Road-guard occupancy reaches 37.31% in NE-west and 47.24% in SE-east, creating broad flat corridors with abrupt relief termination.

immediate_failures.label: 現代物・透かし・署名
immediate_failures.evidence: No modern element, watermark, logo, or signature was found.

immediate_failures.label: 遠近法化・縮尺の急変
immediate_failures.evidence: There are no scenic side faces, horizon, or cast shadows; bright centers still reduce stylistic continuity but do not form a full oblique projection.

immediate_failures.label: 建物・樹木・岩の不自然な反復
immediate_failures.evidence: At least eight north-east and seven south-east bright-centered radial rosettes repeat the same sunburst grammar.

scores.label: 正典・地形形状との一致
scores.notes: Canonical protected pixels are exact, while all four foothills are unreadable.

scores.label: 親子ズームの連続性
scores.notes: Palette continues; relief grammar and terrain hierarchy do not.

scores.label: 隣接画像の継ぎ目
scores.notes: External borders pass, but road guards create strong internal mask seams.

scores.label: 画風・色・線密度
scores.notes: Plan view is retained; repeated radial rosettes are incompatible with irregular fall-line hachure.

scores.label: 縮尺相応の情報量
scores.notes: Main terrain is dense and secondary terrain is missing.

scores.label: 生成破綻・反復模様
scores.notes: Repeated rosettes and mask-shaped gaps dominate the edit.

scores.label: ベクター重畳時の可読性
scores.notes: Exact line protection helps, but surrounding relief and voids compete with overlays.

summary: G3 is independently rejected. It preserves canonical pixels and canvas edges, but all four foothills are unreadable, repeated radial rosettes remain, and 64px road guards create visible internal terrain voids.
required_changes: Narrow road and detail protection to actual canonical linework so the 37–47% foothill losses and road-shaped voids are removed without moving protected geometry.
In a later isolated generation change, forbid convergent centers and bright summits and use short non-radial unequal hachures.
